name: report-long
description: Multi-page long-form report with title page, table of contents (auto-generated from heading levels 1–2), and multiple sections separated by page breaks. Each section has H1 + body + optional H2 subsections.
when_to_use: Annual report, white paper, multi-section research document, policy brief. When the brief says 'report', 'long-form doc', 'research write-up', 'annual review'. Note: the TOC field renders empty in the file until the user opens it in Word and updates fields (standard .docx behaviour).
